title: 第二十五章 玉面公主第二十六章 白寅玉面公主的招揽
slug: 西游从蜈蚣精到百目真君
content_zh:
那只狐狸体型不大，通体雪白，没有一根杂毛，白得像是一捧刚从天上落下的新雪。
六条蓬松的狐尾在她身后轻轻摇曳。
每一条尾巴尖上都泛着一层淡青色的灵光，那光芒清冷而柔和，如同月华凝成。
她的眼眸是琥珀色的，清澈透亮，带着一股天生的灵秀之气。
一身妖气并不如何强横，却纯净到了极致。
没有半分寻常妖修的驳杂与浊重，反倒有一种近乎于天地灵根般的澄澈通透。
吴耀微微挑眉。
六尾，这个品阶在狐族之中已属上乘。
狐族修行以尾数为尊，一尾为凡狐，三尾为妖狐，六尾已算灵狐。
若能修到九尾，那便是天狐之姿，可与上古神兽比肩。
这只六尾灵狐的修为尚浅。
显然还未完全长成，但那股纯净到极致的灵气，足以说明她的根脚不凡。
正思量间，那只六尾灵狐周身忽然泛起一层莹莹光华，狐身在一片朦胧的光影中渐渐拉伸变幻。
六条狐尾次第收起，雪白的毛发褪去，取而代之的是一袭如月光流泻般的银白长裙。
一个女子的身影从光华中央走了出来。
那是一个极美的女子。
一袭银白长裙曳地，裙摆上隐隐有月华流转。
乌黑的长发如瀑布般垂至腰际，发间只簪了一支素白的玉簪，别无他饰。
她的眉眼生得极为精致，却不是那种妖冶妩媚的狐精之相。
反而带着一股清冷淡然的气质。

像是深山中独自生长了千年的幽兰，不争不媚，自有一种遗世独立的风华。
这份气质，与寻常狐妖截然不同。
寻常狐妖化形，多是艳丽妖娆、风情万种，举手投足间都带着勾魂摄魄的媚意。
可眼前这女子，清冷得不像是狐妖，倒更像是哪个仙家宗门的嫡传弟子。
那几只地仙境界的狐狸精在她化形之后，态度愈发恭谨，齐齐俯首行礼，显然这六尾灵狐在狐族之中的地位非同一般。
吴耀多看了两眼便收回了目光。
这六尾灵狐的根脚恐怕比他猜想的还要深一些，但眼下与他无关。
他将目光又扫过平台其余各处。
四百余位地仙中。
觉醒了血脉神通的妖族不下数十位，人族修士中也有不少人周身道韵凝实了许多。
有的人面上难掩喜色，有的人仍在闭目消化最后的感悟。
所有人都在这场大地意境的洗礼中或多或少地往前迈了一步，而这一步，是独属于万寿山五庄观的缘法。
content_en:
The fox was small in size and was all white without a single hair. It was as white as a handful of fresh snow that had just fallen from the sky.
Six fluffy fox tails swayed gently behind her.
There is a layer of light cyan light on the tip of each tail. The light is cold and soft, like moonlight condensed.
Her eyes are amber, clear and translucent, with a natural aura of beauty.
The demonic aura is not very tyrannical, but is extremely pure.
There is not even half of the complexity and turbidity of ordinary demon cultivators, but instead there is a clarity and transparency that is almost as clear as the spiritual roots of heaven and earth.
Wu Yao raised his eyebrows slightly.
Vulpix, this rank is already superior among the fox clan.
In the practice of the fox clan, the last number is respected, one tail is an ordinary fox, three tails are a demon fox, and six tails are considered a spirit fox.
If one could cultivate the Nine Tails, he would have the appearance of a celestial fox, comparable to the ancient beasts.
The cultivation level of this six-tailed spirit fox is still shallow.
It's obvious that she hasn't fully grown yet, but her extremely pure aura is enough to show that she has extraordinary roots.
While he was thinking about it, a layer of gleaming light suddenly appeared all over the body of the six-tailed fox, and the fox's body gradually stretched and changed in the hazy light and shadow.
The six fox tails were put away one after another, and the snow-white hair faded away, replaced by a silver-white dress like the moonlight flowing down.
A female figure walked out of the center of the light.
That is a very beautiful woman.
She was wearing a silver-white dress that was trailing to the floor, and there was a faint moonlight flowing on the skirt.
Her long black hair hangs down to her waist like a waterfall, with only a plain white jade hairpin in her hair and no other ornaments.
Her eyebrows are extremely delicate, but they don't look like a coquettish and charming vixen.
Instead, he had a cool and indifferent temperament.
Like an orchid that has grown alone in the mountains for thousands of years, it is neither competitive nor flattering, and has its own independent elegance.
This temperament is completely different from ordinary fox demons.
Ordinary fox demons take the form of most beautiful, enchanting and charming creatures, with a seductive charm in every move and every move.
But the woman in front of him was so cold that she didn't look like a fox demon, but more like a direct disciple of some immortal sect.
The vixens in the earthly immortal realm became more respectful after she transformed, and they all bowed their heads and saluted. It was obvious that the status of these six-tailed foxes in the fox clan was extraordinary.
Wu Yaoduo looked at it twice and then withdrew his gaze.
The six-tailed spirit fox's roots were probably deeper than he expected, but it had nothing to do with him at the moment.
He glanced at the rest of the platform.
Among more than four hundred earthly immortals.
There are no fewer than dozens of demon clans who have awakened their bloodline magical powers, and there are also many human monks whose Dao charm has become much more solidified.
Some people couldn't hide their joy, while others were still closing their eyes to digest the final insights.
Everyone has more or less taken a step forward in this baptism of the artistic conception of the earth, and this step is unique to the Wuzhuang Temple in Wanshou Mountain.
